t: This is the Reform Club, a Grade I listed gentlemen's club on the south side of Pall Mall. It has been home to progressive political ideas since its foundation in 1836, and its first members were Radicals and Whigs. Today it is a purely social club, with no party attached. It was one of the first all-male clubs to admit women on equal terms, in 1981. The building was designed by Charles Barry, the architect best known for rebuilding the Palace of Westminster, and a leading figure in bringing Italianate architecture to Britain.
